meta.name: WeOpen Redy Motion Tokens
meta.description: Motion timing, easing, and interaction patterns for Redy brand surfaces, loaders, feedback states, and lightweight mascot moments.

instant.$description: Tiny state changes such as icon tint, focus ring, and CLI cursor feedback.

fast.$description: Button hover, badge reveal, and small affordance transitions.

base.$description: Default UI motion for panels, cards, and gentle Redy expression changes.

slow.$description: Mascot entrance, 404 helper reveal, and README banner detail fade.

ambient.$description: Soft idle loops such as goggle glint, branch pulse, or tail breathing.

standard.$description: Calm default easing. Use for most Redy UI and brand transitions.

enter.$description: Soft entrance that feels ready and reliable rather than bouncy.

exit.$description: Quick exit for panels, helper tips, and transient feedback.

gentleSpring.$description: Restrained mascot and sticker motion. Avoid high-bounce cartoon behavior.

goggleGlint.$description: Small Git-green lens glint for loading and active technical states.

branchPulse.$description: Commit-node pulse for WeGit or merge-success feedback.

softAppear.$description: Default entry for Redy illustrations, cards, banners, and empty states.

tinyWave.$description: Small hello gesture for the Q-version mascot and onboarding moments.

reducedMotion.$description: All decorative loops must pause or collapse to a single opacity change when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

maxDecorativeLoopCount.$description: Decorative loops should stop after three cycles unless they represent an active loading state.
